name: SimCityNet
evidence: Both the original deep URL and the original repository API return HTTP 404. GitHub public repository search finds hpa-code/simcitynet, which returns 200 and explicitly cites the exact Caliskan/Iskakov/Li/McCollum/Ren paper DOI 10.2139/ssrn.5369073. Its pyproject lists these five authors. Its owner profile is Hari Prasad Acharya, University of Rochester, and it was created 18 November 2026. No redirect, transfer, or first-party statement establishes it as the replacement for X0X0X00/SimCity-Net; do not automatically assert a rename. Its linked documentation returns 404 and PyPI simcitynet returns 404. A verified matching implementation candidate is available, but the canonical author-maintained repository remains unconfirmed.
